name: left_L0_sky_far_corrected
prompt:

Image 2 is the CENTER panel's extracted transparent sky+far-coast layer, color and joining-edge reference only.
Keep Image 1 exact 2001x786 canvas, skyline position, buildings/cranes and coastline at y=300..305, true alpha transparent everywhere below coastline. Do not bring back any sea, ground or props.
Correct its sky COLOR CONTINUITY for placing Image 1 immediately TO THE LEFT OF Image 2: Image 1 RIGHT EDGE must match Image 2 LEFT EDGE. Currently image 1 right sky is too orange/red.
